data.name: Aksana
data.gender_notes: Aksana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Aksana means 'helping hand', 'support'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'askana', which means 'to help'. This name is a reminder of the importance of providing assistance and support to others in times of need, embodying the spirit of compassion and kindness. The name Aksana carries the meaning “Helping hand, support” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aksana usually hope their child will grow to embody helping hand, support and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aksana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helping hand, support.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aksana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
